description: Placeholder rules for SIA Building Contract 2016, lump sum. Values are taken from the source document (see source and each rule's notes); anything still TODO_VERIFY was not found or does not fit the trigger. Structured facts only; no contract text.
source: docs/contracts: SIA_Building_Contract_2016_Without_Quantities_Domestic_1st_ED_EA.pdf (1st Ed Nov 2016, EA Jul 2017). Values extracted 2026-11-24; to be checked by a contracts professional.

rules.obligation: Respond to the interim payment claim (payment response or certificate)
rules.notes: SOP Act cap applies on top (sopa.payment_response). Source: SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA) cl 40(3): the Employer serves the payment response within 21 calendar days of receipt of the payment claim. Interim Certificates are issued on the Appendix dates (31(1)(b)).

rules.obligation: Give notice of a delaying event and claim an extension of time
rules.notes: Source: SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA) cl 23(3)(a): notify the Architect within 28 days of the event, Direction or Instruction; the notice is a condition precedent. Not needed if the Architect has already said he will extend (23(3)(b)).

rules.obligation: Decide on the extension of time claim
rules.notes: Trigger mismatch: SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA) cl 23(3)(d): Architect says whether the event entitles an EOT on receipt of the notice, and within 28 days of a Contractor request citing this clause. No fixed period from the notice itself.

rules.obligation: Confirm the oral instruction in writing
rules.notes: Source: SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA) cl 1(2)(b): Contractor requests written confirmation of a verbal Direction/Instruction within 7 days; Architect confirms within 14 days. 1(2)(f): no compensation without confirmation.

rules.obligation: Object to the instruction, if you dispute it
rules.notes: Source: SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA) cl 1(4)(b): within 28 days of a Direction, dispute its classification, claim payment or give notice of arbitration in writing, else deemed to comply at no cost. Extended under 1(4)(c).

rules.obligation: Give notice of claim or a quotation for the variation
rules.notes: Source: SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA) cl 12(5)(b): within 7 days of a Direction or Instruction, submit a price breakdown (and milestones if required). If not, the QS values without it (12(5)(c)).
Not found in SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA): the QS values variations in Interim Certificates under cl 31; cl 12 sets no period for the valuation.

rules.obligation: Object to the valuation of the variation, if you dispute it
rules.notes: Not found in SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA): cl 12 sets no period to object to a valuation. Consider rejecting this rule for this form.

No fixed period: SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA) cl 31(9)(a): Final Account Claim after completion and the last statutory instrument, or before the end of the Maintenance Period, whichever is later. 31(9)(d): not submitting it waives rights.

Source: SIA Building Contract 2016 (Without Quantities, 1st Ed EA) cl 27(1)-(2): make good defects forthwith. If not, under 27(3)(c)(i) and 1(6)(a) the Employer may employ others 7 days after the Architect's written notice requiring compliance.
